summary: Building a mod in a bounded child process: stage, pack once, verify, gate and promote exactly once.
work: Stages every product, packs with WolvenKit, runs the verifiers and promotes the candidate.
cancel: The child process tree is killed.
cleanup: The candidate folder is removed unless promoted.
deadline: PACKAGE_BUILD_DEADLINE_MS, with one retry after a stale prerequisite
lane: host builder process, one at a time

faults.when: A prerequisite changed during the build.

x-friction.gap: Promotion happens once even across a crash.
No progress is published while a Build runs for minutes.
x-friction.closes: Progress streamed from host work to the page.
